knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

## 0. Setup

This workflow calculates allometric scaling of cumulative GPP and ER against cumulative upstream drainage area. Cumulative values include each focal reach plus all retained upstream reaches.

```{r}

source("../scripts/00_setup.R")

tic("run 07")

pacman::p_load(knitr, 
               ggrepel)

dir_processed <- file.path("../data/processed")
dir_merit <- file.path(dir_processed, "merit_data")
dir_figs <- file.path("figures")

dir.create(dir_figs, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

path_cat <- file.path(dir_merit, "03_cat_pfaf_7_MERIT_Hydro_v07_Basins_v01_CONUS_filtered.shp")
path_riv <- file.path(dir_merit, "03_riv_pfaf_7_MERIT_Hydro_v07_Basins_v01_CONUS_filtered.shp")
path_upstream_lookup <- file.path(dir_merit, "05_upstream_lookup.rds")

path_metabolism <- file.path(dir_processed, "01_assembled_maavara_monthly_metabolism.rds")
path_characteristics <- file.path("../data/raw/dryad_data/scaling_dataset_Qmonth_06082024.csv")

path_allometry_data <- file.path(dir_processed, "07_huc08_allometry_input.rds")
path_allometry_results <- file.path(dir_processed, "07_huc08_allometry_results.csv")
path_negative_rate_log <- file.path(dir_processed, "07_negative_rate_recode_summary.csv")

missing_area_threshold <- 10
missing_metabolism_threshold <- 10
min_reaches <- 20
min_area_range_log10 <- 1
```

## 1. Read filtered spatial, routing, and metabolism data

```{r}
tic("Read data")

merit_cat_v2 <- read_sf(path_cat) %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(comid = as.character(comid))

merit_riv_v2 <- read_sf(path_riv) %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(
    comid = as.character(comid),
    nxt_dw = as.character(nxt_dw),
    huc = as.character(huc)
  )

upstream_lookup <- base::readRDS(path_upstream_lookup) %>%
  mutate(
    downstream_comid = as.character(downstream_comid),
    upstream_comid = as.character(upstream_comid)
  )

metabolism_raw <- base::readRDS(path_metabolism) %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(comid = as.character(comid))

comid_characteristics <- read_csv(path_characteristics, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(comid = as.character(comid))

toc()
```

```{r}
metabolism <- metabolism_raw

if ("gpp_g_o2_m2_d" %in% names(metabolism)) {
  metabolism <- metabolism %>%
    rename(
      gpp_rate_g_o2_m2_d = gpp_g_o2_m2_d,
      er_rate_g_o2_m2_d = er_g_o2_m2_d
    )
} else {
  metabolism <- metabolism %>%
    rename(
      gpp_rate_g_o2_m2_d = gpp,
      er_rate_g_o2_m2_d = er
    )
}

metabolism <- metabolism %>%
  select(comid, month, gpp_rate_g_o2_m2_d, er_rate_g_o2_m2_d)

# Preserve the assembled source in 01; only the analysis copy is recoded.
# Negative local metabolism rates cannot contribute to cumulative flux.
negative_rate_log <- tibble(
  metabolism_metric = c("GPP", "ER"),
  n_rates = rep(nrow(metabolism), 2),
  n_negative_set_na = c(
    sum(metabolism$gpp_rate_g_o2_m2_d < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(metabolism$er_rate_g_o2_m2_d < 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
)
write_csv(negative_rate_log, path_negative_rate_log)
metabolism <- metabolism %>%
  mutate(
    gpp_rate_g_o2_m2_d = if_else(
      !is.na(gpp_rate_g_o2_m2_d) & gpp_rate_g_o2_m2_d < 0,
      NA_real_, gpp_rate_g_o2_m2_d
    ),
    er_rate_g_o2_m2_d = if_else(
      !is.na(er_rate_g_o2_m2_d) & er_rate_g_o2_m2_d < 0,
      NA_real_, er_rate_g_o2_m2_d
    )
  )
negative_rate_log %>% kable()
```

```{r}
tibble(
  dataset = c("Filtered catchments", "Filtered flowlines", "Upstream lookup", "Monthly metabolism"),
  rows = c(nrow(merit_cat_v2), nrow(merit_riv_v2), nrow(upstream_lookup), nrow(metabolism)),
  unique_comids = c(
    n_distinct(merit_cat_v2$comid),
    n_distinct(merit_riv_v2$comid),
    n_distinct(upstream_lookup$downstream_comid),
    n_distinct(metabolism$comid)
  )
) %>%
  kable()
```

## 2. Build reach attributes and local metabolism fluxes

Maavara metabolism is an areal rate. Here it is converted to reach-scale flux using stream surface area: `lengthkm × 1000 × merit_width`.

```{r}
reach_attributes <- merit_cat_v2 %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(comid, huc, unitarea) %>%
  left_join(
    merit_riv_v2 %>%
      st_drop_geometry() %>%
      select(comid, uparea),
    by = "comid"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    comid_characteristics %>%
      select(comid, lengthkm, merit_width, order),
    by = "comid"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    stream_area_m2 = lengthkm * 1000 * merit_width
  )

local_metabolism <- metabolism %>%
  inner_join(reach_attributes, by = "comid") %>%
  mutate(
    gpp_flux_g_o2_d = gpp_rate_g_o2_m2_d * stream_area_m2,
    er_flux_g_o2_d = er_rate_g_o2_m2_d * stream_area_m2
  )
```

```{r}
reach_attributes %>%
  summarise(
    n_reaches = n(),
    n_missing_unitarea = sum(is.na(unitarea)),
    n_missing_width = sum(is.na(merit_width)),
    n_missing_length = sum(is.na(lengthkm)),
    n_missing_stream_area = sum(is.na(stream_area_m2))
  ) %>%
  kable()
```

```{r, fig.width=7, fig.height=4}

local_metabolism %>%
  filter(month == 7) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    c(gpp_flux_g_o2_d, er_flux_g_o2_d),
    names_to = "metabolism_metric",
    values_to = "local_flux_g_o2_d"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    metabolism_metric = recode(
      metabolism_metric,
      gpp_flux_g_o2_d = "GPP",
      er_flux_g_o2_d = "ER"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(local_flux_g_o2_d > 0) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = local_flux_g_o2_d)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 60) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  facet_wrap(~ metabolism_metric, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    x = "Local reach flux (g O2 d-1)",
    y = "Number of reach-months"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

## 3. Calculate cumulative upstream area

```{r}
retained_upstream_area <- upstream_lookup %>%
  inner_join(
    reach_attributes %>%
      select(upstream_comid = comid, upstream_unitarea = unitarea),
    by = "upstream_comid"
  ) %>%
  group_by(downstream_comid) %>%
  summarise(
    cumulative_area_km2 = sum(upstream_unitarea, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_upstream_reaches = n_distinct(upstream_comid),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    reach_attributes %>%
      select(downstream_comid = comid, huc, uparea),
    by = "downstream_comid"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    area_ratio_retained = cumulative_area_km2 / uparea,
    pct_area_missing = pmax(0, 1 - area_ratio_retained) * 100
  )
```

```{r}
retained_upstream_area %>%
  summarise(
    n_reaches = n(),
    median_area_ratio = median(area_ratio_retained, na.rm = TRUE),
    p05_area_ratio = quantile(area_ratio_retained, 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    p95_area_ratio = quantile(area_ratio_retained, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_ge_10pct_missing = sum(pct_area_missing >= 10, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  kable(digits = 3)
```

```{r, fig.width=6, fig.height=5}
ggplot(retained_upstream_area, aes(x = uparea, y = cumulative_area_km2)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.15, size = 0.3) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(
    x = "MERIT upstream drainage area, uparea (km²)",
    y = "Retained cumulative upstream area (km²)"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

## 4. Calculate cumulative upstream metabolism

```{r}
tic("Calculate cumulative metabolism")

cumulative_metabolism <- upstream_lookup %>%
  inner_join(
    local_metabolism %>%
      select(
        upstream_comid = comid,
        month,
        unitarea,
        gpp_flux_g_o2_d,
        er_flux_g_o2_d
      ),
    by = "upstream_comid",
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) %>%
  group_by(downstream_comid, month) %>%
  summarise(
    cumulative_gpp_g_o2_d = if_else(
      any(!is.na(gpp_flux_g_o2_d)),
      sum(gpp_flux_g_o2_d, na.rm = TRUE),
      NA_real_
    ),
    cumulative_er_g_o2_d = if_else(
      any(!is.na(er_flux_g_o2_d)),
      sum(er_flux_g_o2_d, na.rm = TRUE),
      NA_real_
    ),
    
    gpp_covered_area_km2 = sum(
      unitarea[!is.na(gpp_flux_g_o2_d)],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    er_covered_area_km2 = sum(
      unitarea[!is.na(er_flux_g_o2_d)],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    
    n_gpp_reaches = sum(!is.na(gpp_flux_g_o2_d)),
    n_er_reaches = sum(!is.na(er_flux_g_o2_d)),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(retained_upstream_area, by = "downstream_comid") %>%
  mutate(
    pct_gpp_metabolism_missing =
      (1 - gpp_covered_area_km2 / cumulative_area_km2) * 100,
    
    pct_er_metabolism_missing =
      (1 - er_covered_area_km2 / cumulative_area_km2) * 100
  )

toc()
```

```{r}
allometry_data <- cumulative_metabolism %>%
  pivot_longer(
    c(cumulative_gpp_g_o2_d, cumulative_er_g_o2_d),
    names_to = "metabolism_metric",
    values_to = "cumulative_flux_g_o2_d"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    metabolism_metric = recode(
      metabolism_metric,
      cumulative_gpp_g_o2_d = "GPP",
      cumulative_er_g_o2_d = "ER"
    ),
    pct_metabolism_missing = if_else(
      metabolism_metric == "GPP",
      pct_gpp_metabolism_missing,
      pct_er_metabolism_missing
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(huc),
    !is.na(month),
    cumulative_area_km2 > 0,
    cumulative_flux_g_o2_d > 0,
    pct_area_missing < missing_area_threshold,
    is.finite(pct_metabolism_missing),
    pct_metabolism_missing < missing_metabolism_threshold
  )

base::saveRDS(allometry_data, path_allometry_data)
```

```{r}
allometry_data %>%
  summarise(
    n_rows = n(),
    n_hucs = n_distinct(huc),
    n_downstream_comids = n_distinct(downstream_comid),
    n_months = n_distinct(month),
    pct_gpp = mean(metabolism_metric == "GPP") * 100,
    pct_er = mean(metabolism_metric == "ER") * 100
  ) %>%
  kable(digits = 2)
```

## 5. Select one example HUC8 for visual QC

The example HUC is selected automatically to have many usable reaches, broad drainage-area range, and low missing upstream area.

```{r}
example_huc <- allometry_data %>%
  group_by(huc) %>%
  summarise(
    n_reaches = n_distinct(downstream_comid),
    log10_area_range = log10(max(cumulative_area_km2, na.rm = TRUE) / min(cumulative_area_km2, na.rm = TRUE)),
    median_pct_area_missing = median(pct_area_missing, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n_reaches >= 100, log10_area_range >= 2, median_pct_area_missing < 1) %>%
  arrange(desc(log10_area_range), desc(n_reaches)) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  pull(huc)

example_huc
```

```{r}
example_data <- allometry_data %>%
  filter(huc == example_huc)

example_month <- example_data %>%
  filter(metabolism_metric == "GPP") %>%
  count(month, sort = TRUE) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  pull(month)

example_month
```

```{r}
example_map <- merit_riv_v2 %>%
  semi_join(
    example_data %>%
      filter(month == example_month, metabolism_metric == "GPP") %>%
      distinct(downstream_comid),
    by = c("comid" = "downstream_comid")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    example_data %>%
      filter(month == example_month, metabolism_metric == "GPP") %>%
      select(downstream_comid, cumulative_area_km2, cumulative_flux_g_o2_d),
    by = c("comid" = "downstream_comid")
  )
```

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = example_map,
    aes(color = cumulative_area_km2, linewidth = cumulative_area_km2),
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(
    option = "magma",
    trans = "log10",
    name = "Cumulative\narea (km²)"
  ) +
  scale_linewidth_continuous(
    trans = "log10",
    range = c(0.05, 1.1),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  labs(title = paste0("Example HUC8 ", example_huc, ": cumulative drainage area")) +
  theme_map() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )
```

## 6. Visual proof of cumulative scaling for one HUC8

```{r}
example_labels <- example_data %>%
  filter(month == example_month) %>%
  group_by(metabolism_metric) %>%
  arrange(cumulative_area_km2) %>%
  slice(c(1, round(n() / 2), n())) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    label = paste0(
      "A=", scales::comma(round(cumulative_area_km2)), " km²\n",
      "F=", scales::scientific(cumulative_flux_g_o2_d, digits = 2)
    )
  )
```

```{r, fig.width=9, fig.height=5}
ggplot(
  example_data %>%
    filter(month == example_month),
  aes(x = cumulative_area_km2, y = cumulative_flux_g_o2_d)
) +
  geom_point(aes(color = pct_area_missing), alpha = 0.65, size = 1.2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_label_repel(
    data = example_labels,
    aes(label = label),
    size = 3,
    label.size = 0.15,
    min.segment.length = 0
  ) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_color_viridis_c(
    option = "magma",
    limits = c(0, missing_area_threshold),
    name = "% area\nmissing"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ metabolism_metric, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Example HUC8 ", example_huc, ", month ", example_month),
    x = "Cumulative upstream drainage area (km²)",
    y = "Cumulative upstream metabolism (g O2 d-1)"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
```

## 7. Fit HUC8 allometric scaling relationships

Model: `log10(cumulative metabolism) ~ log10(cumulative upstream area)`.

```{r}
allometry_results <- allometry_data %>%
  group_by(huc, month, metabolism_metric) %>%
  filter(
    n() >= min_reaches,
    n_distinct(cumulative_area_km2) >= min_reaches,
    log10(max(cumulative_area_km2, na.rm = TRUE) / min(cumulative_area_km2, na.rm = TRUE)) >= min_area_range_log10
  ) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    fit <- lm(log10(cumulative_flux_g_o2_d) ~ log10(cumulative_area_km2), data = .x)
    
    tibble(
      n_reaches = nrow(.x),
      log10_area_range = log10(max(.x$cumulative_area_km2, na.rm = TRUE) / min(.x$cumulative_area_km2, na.rm = TRUE)),
      median_pct_area_missing = median(.x$pct_area_missing, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_pct_metabolism_missing = median(.x$pct_metabolism_missing, na.rm = TRUE),
      intercept = coef(fit)[1],
      slope = coef(fit)[2],
      r2 = summary(fit)$r.squared
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    slope_class_simple = case_when(
      r2 < 0.8 ~ "low_r2",
      slope < 0.95 ~ "sublinear",
      slope <= 1.05 ~ "near_linear",
      slope > 1.05 ~ "superlinear",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

write_csv(allometry_results, path_allometry_results)
```

```{r}
allometry_results %>%
  summarise(
    n_fits = n(),
    n_hucs = n_distinct(huc),
    median_slope = median(slope, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_r2 = median(r2, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_r2_ge_08 = mean(r2 >= 0.8, na.rm = TRUE) * 100
  ) %>%
  kable(digits = 3)
```

```{r}
allometry_results %>%
  count(metabolism_metric, slope_class_simple, name = "n_fits") %>%
  group_by(metabolism_metric) %>%
  mutate(pct_fits = n_fits / sum(n_fits) * 100) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  kable(digits = 2)
```

## 8. Result diagnostics

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
ggplot(allometry_results, aes(x = slope, fill = metabolism_metric)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.35) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~ metabolism_metric, ncol = 1) +
  labs(
    x = "Allometric slope",
    y = "Density"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r, fig.width=9, fig.height=5}
ggplot(allometry_results, aes(x = factor(month), y = slope)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ metabolism_metric, ncol = 1) +
  labs(
    x = "Month",
    y = "Allometric slope"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
ggplot(allometry_results, aes(x = slope, y = r2)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.35, size = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.8, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~ metabolism_metric) +
  labs(
    x = "Allometric slope",
    y = expression(R^2)
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```
